title: Account names and labels: PATCH /accounts/:id and label filters
description:
Tenants with hundreds of wallets want to tag them (team, region, cost centre) and find them again, and to fix a typo in an account name without opening a new account.

- Migration 0009 adds `accounts.labels jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'` (must be an object) with a GIN `jsonb_path_ops` index for containment queries.
- `PATCH /accounts/:id` (scope `accounts:write`) takes `name` and/or `labels`; `name` follows the same rules as when an account is opened. `labels` replaces the whole set (`{}` clears it): at most 20 pairs, keys of letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-` up to 40 characters, string values up to 100 that contain no NUL character and no unpaired surrogate (Postgres rejects both, so they are a 400). Closed accounts can be updated too since only descriptive fields change; balances are never touched. Unknown fields and an empty body are 400.
- `GET /accounts?label=key:value` filters by label; repeat `label` and every pair must match (each becomes a `labels @> '{"key": "value"}'` condition). The first `:` separates key and value, so values may contain colons.
- Account responses now include `labels`.

Tests in `test/api/accountLabels.test.ts` cover renaming and relabelling, validation, filtering by one and several labels, malformed filters, scopes and tenant isolation. README updated.
